claim: OWASP APTS defines 173 tier-required requirements across 8 governance domains for autonomous penetration testing platforms.
stance_target: structure of autonomous pentest governance standards
scope_conditions: OWASP incubator-stage project, v0.1.0, as of Oct 2026

claim: The 8 OWASP APTS domains are Scope Enforcement (26 reqs), Safety Controls (20), Human Oversight (19), Graduated Autonomy (28), Auditability (20), Manipulation Resistance (23), Supply Chain Trust (22), and Reporting (15).
stance_target: taxonomy of autonomous pentest governance domains
quoted_support: Scope Enforcement (SE) — 26 requirements / Safety Controls (SC) — 20 requirements / Human Oversight (HO) — 19 requirements / Graduated Autonomy (AL) — 28 requirements

claim: OWASP APTS has three cumulative compliance tiers: Tier 1 Foundation (72 requirements, minimum bar for responsible deployment), Tier 2 Verified (157 cumulative, full transparency and tamper-proof audit trails), and Tier 3 Comprehensive (173 cumulative, highest assurance for critical infrastructure).
stance_target: tiered conformance structure for autonomous pentest platforms
quoted_support: Tier 1 - Foundation: 72 requirements. Minimum bar for responsible deployment. / Tier 2 - Verified: 157 cumulative. Full transparency and tamper-proof audit trails. / Tier 3 - Comprehensive: 173 cumulative. Highest assurance for critical infrastructure.

claim: OWASP APTS is explicitly a governance standard, not a testing methodology, and is designed to complement existing methodologies by addressing problems unique to autonomous operation.
stance_target: need for separate governance layer on top of existing pentest methodologies for autonomous agents
quoted_support: APTS is not a testing methodology. It complements PTES, OWASP WSTG, and OSSTMM by addressing the problems unique to autonomous operation: scope enforcement, safe autonomy, manipulation resistance, and accountability.

claim: The OWASP APTS landing page does not specify an explicit recommended scan cadence or frequency for autonomous pentest operations.
stance_target: whether APTS mandates a specific testing cadence
scope_conditions: based on the public project landing page content only, not the full requirement documents on GitHub
quoted_support: Building a platform? Use the Checklists for your target tier, then the domain requirement documents.
